nodes.name: finance-rules.ts

nodes.name: font-loader.ts
nodes.summary: Google Fonts loader with local/system font fallback detection and caching.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Number and date formatting utilities for money, dates, percentages, and short date keys.

nodes.name: fuzzy-search.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight fuzzy string matching and filtered index search over record arrays.

nodes.name: pending-edit.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory pending edit store for tracking unsaved edits by resource type and record ID.

nodes.name: query-provider.tsx
nodes.summary: React Query provider wrapper that configures the QueryClient for the renderer app.

nodes.name: router.tsx
nodes.summary: Hash-based client-side router with section parsing, navigation hooks, and a Link component.

nodes.name: context.tsx
nodes.summary: Keyboard shortcut provider with combo detection, action registry, undo/redo stack, and cheat sheet toggle.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Central keyboard shortcut definitions with platform-aware display and key mapping.

nodes.summary: Theme provider supporting light/dark mode, custom accent colors, font loading, and localStorage persistence.

nodes.summary: UI settings provider that loads, caches, and persists user preferences including theme, filters, fonts, and workspace layout.

nodes.name: use-debounced-persist.ts

nodes.name: isCreditLikeAccountType
nodes.summary: Checks if an account type string indicates a credit-like account.

nodes.name: calculateTotalCashFlow
nodes.summary: Sums cash balances across non-credit, active accounts.

nodes.name: isAuxiliaryIncomeCategory
nodes.summary: Returns true if the income category label is an auxiliary/workflow-only category.

nodes.name: getNormalIncomeCategories
nodes.summary: Filters a list of income categories to exclude auxiliary categories.

nodes.name: shouldShowCreditExpenseFields
nodes.summary: Determines whether credit-card-specific expense fields should be visible based on account type.

nodes.name: shouldShowPasabuyFields
nodes.summary: Determines whether Pasabuy-specific expense fields should be visible based on view mode and category.

nodes.name: getExpenseConditionalSections
nodes.summary: Returns conditional field sections for the expense form based on account type and category.

nodes.name: getWorkflowFixedCategory
nodes.summary: Returns the fixed category name for a workflow section.

nodes.name: isMonthlyMonitoringEditable
nodes.summary: Checks whether the monthly monitoring section is user-editable.

nodes.name: calculateNetIncome
nodes.summary: Subtracts capital expenditure from gross income and rounds the result.

nodes.name: calculateCategoryTotalOverview
nodes.summary: Computes total overshoot from category spending with a breakdown of over-budget amounts.

nodes.name: calculateGrossPrice
nodes.summary: Calculates gross price from expense amount plus interest.

nodes.name: calculateInstallmentAmount
nodes.summary: Computes per-installment amount from gross price and number of installments with zero-division guard.

nodes.name: calculatePaidAmount
nodes.summary: Calculates total paid amount from installments, considering partial payments and remaining balance.

nodes.name: calculateRemainingBalance
nodes.summary: Subtracts paid amount from gross price with floor at zero.

nodes.name: calculatePasabuyReceivedAmount
nodes.summary: Computes total received amount for a Pasabuy expense across all installment-like splits.

nodes.name: calculatePasabuyerBalance
nodes.summary: Computes remaining Pasabuyer balance as gross price minus received amount.

nodes.name: calculateExpectedPaymentDate
nodes.summary: Calculates expected payment date given purchase date, cutoff day, and statement cycle.

nodes.name: getMoneyValueTone
nodes.summary: Returns a qualitative tone label for a numeric money value (e.g. significant, manageable).

nodes.name: isPasabuyCategoryName
nodes.summary: Checks if a category name string matches the Pasabuy pattern.

nodes.name: isPasabuyCategory
nodes.summary: Checks if an expense category object is a Pasabuy category.

nodes.name: isOutstandingExpense
nodes.summary: Returns true if an expense record is unpaid and not a scheduled recurring entry.

nodes.name: shouldShowGlobalMonthSelector
nodes.summary: Determines whether the global month selector should be displayed based on current section and data availability.

nodes.name: getMonthKeyFromIsoDate
nodes.summary: Extracts a YYYY-MM key from an ISO date string.

nodes.name: isIncomeRecordInViewScope
nodes.summary: Checks if an income record should be visible in the current view scope (month/week/day).

nodes.name: isExpenseRecordInViewScope
nodes.summary: Checks if an expense record should be visible in the current view scope (month/week/day).

nodes.name: getExpenseStatusFromDatePaid
nodes.summary: Returns expense payment status label from date_paid presence.

nodes.name: isUnpaidPasabuyExpense
nodes.summary: Checks if a Pasabuy expense is unpaid by comparing sent vs received amounts.

nodes.name: isCreditAccountExpense
nodes.summary: Checks if an expense record's account is a credit-like account.

nodes.name: parseIsoDate
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO date string into a Date object with validation.

nodes.name: isIsoDateInViewScope
nodes.summary: Determines if a raw ISO date falls within month, week, or day view scope relative to a reference date.

nodes.name: loadGoogleFont
nodes.summary: Loads a Google Font by injecting a link element, with caching and local/system font guard.

nodes.name: formatMoney
nodes.summary: Formats a numeric value as localized currency string with configurable precision.

nodes.summary: Formats a date input to a localized date string with validation.

nodes.summary: Converts an ISO date string to compact YYMMDD format.

nodes.summary: Performs case-insensitive fuzzy character-by-character matching between query and target strings.

nodes.summary: Retrieves and removes the pending edit for a resource type.

nodes.summary: Clears all pending edits from the store.
